rdf:Description.dc:title: City swimming pool and Washington Monument in distance
rdf:Description.dc:description: These swimming pools were built between 1907 and 1910 on the site of the US Fish Commission hatching ponds. In addition to the pools there was a building with showers and changing rooms. The pools were removed in 1936.
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Orren R. Louden
rdf:Description.dc:source: The Historical Society of Washington, DC. View original.
